question: Which country will host the 2030 Asian games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Qatar** will host the 2030 Asian Games.
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The event is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and is the second largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.&
